actions.reason: C0001 has coherent WXS identity evidence (strong PBRM1 enrichment with VHL co-mutation and BAP1 depletion), no plausible technical confounder for the WXS-defined signal, and low label echo. Cross-modal support is weak and structure is only uncertain, but no available evidence request remains and no better-supported structural revision is indicated, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0002 shows a coherent albeit modest WXS/CNV profile (DST enrichment with chr12p/12q gain and no VHL enrichment), no set-specific technical confounder, and low label echo. Cross-modal support is weak and resampling stability is low, but no available request or supported structural revision remains, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0003 has strong coherent WXS identity evidence (marked BAP1 enrichment), the tissue-source-site association does not plausibly explain the WXS-defined signal, and label echo is low. Cross-modal support is weak and structure uncertain, but no available request or supported structural revision remains, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has coherent WXS identity evidence (PBRM1 depletion with VHL enrichment), no set-specific technical confounder, and low label echo. Cross-modal support is essentially single-modality WXS and structure is uncertain, but no available request or supported structural revision remains, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0005 has coherent WXS identity evidence (complete absence of VHL/PBRM1 mutations), the CT scanner association does not plausibly explain the WXS-defined signal, and label echo is low. Support is single-modality and the set is very small, but no available request or supported structural revision remains, so it is retained for downstream validation.
